contract: SignRelay GITEX YouthX research-prototype demo, 30 October 2026
scope: Live ASL isolated-sign demo of six words (HELLO, THANK YOU, PLEASE, SORRY, YES, NO) on one prepared laptop with Chrome, plus honest abstention. Not sentence translation; not validated accuracy.

automated.requirement: The camera is requested only after the visitor starts the workspace; a denied permission shows a recoverable message and a retry works.

check.contains: Denied permission did not surface a recoverable error

automated.requirement: While the camera is off, pending, denied or broken, no status claims recognition is running.

check.contains: never claims recognition while the camera is %s

automated.requirement: A camera grant that arrives after leaving or cancelling is released immediately.

check.contains: Late retry grant leaked camera tracks

automated.requirement: Pausing the camera ends every media track and shows camera off.

check.contains: Camera tracks were not released

automated.requirement: Hand tracking starts with jsDelivr and googleapis unreachable, using only self-hosted pinned assets.

check.contains: CDN requests were attempted

automated.requirement: In CI headless Chrome, vision cold start completes in under 15 s and frames reach recognition.

check.contains: Cold start exceeded the 15 s contract

automated.requirement: The scripted six-word sequence confirms each word once, in order, with natural rests (synthetic kinematics).

check.contains: keeps all six words in order with %i ms rests between signs

automated.requirement: Every core word confirms exactly once with no other label across 15 capture conditions (synthetic).

check.contains: confirms exactly once with no other label

automated.requirement: Two-evidence confirmation is preserved: a single proposal never becomes a word.

check.contains: keeps two-evidence confirmation

automated.requirement: Resting hands and a confident closed-set model alone never emit a word; every synthetic everyday-movement outcome matches the documented risk list.

check.contains: matches the documented outcome

automated.requirement: Stale, competing or reset evidence and wrong-language model results never confirm.

check.contains: discards an ASL inference that finishes after switching to BSL

automated.requirement: A duplicate confirmation is neither shown nor spoken; auto speak voices confirmed words only.

check.contains: Auto speak must voice a confirmed word exactly once

automated.requirement: Copy, save-and-clear, history and per-language transcript isolation work; storage failure keeps the transcript.

check.contains: Copy did not place the transcript on the clipboard

automated.requirement: Tentative candidates are not announced; confirmed words are announced to screen readers.

check.contains: Tentative candidates must not be announced as translations

automated.requirement: The workspace and capture studio fit a 390 px phone viewport without horizontal overflow.

check.contains: Workspace overflows a phone viewport

automated.requirement: The private capture studio is absent from public exports and deploys.

check.contains: must not ship in a public export

automated.requirement: No camera data is uploaded by the capture studio.

check.contains: Camera data must not be POSTed

automated.requirement: A stalled or crashed recognition worker restarts, then pauses with a manual restart after repeated failures.

check.contains: limits automatic restarts and allows an explicit retry

automated.requirement: Displayed capability claims quote the committed evaluation exactly and never claim validation or measured live accuracy.

check.contains: quotes the ASL development result exactly

automated.requirement: The ASL demo build makes no request that leaves the machine: page and worker requests are loopback only, behind a deny-all proxy (npm run demo:check).

check.contains: Outbound connections were attempted

automated.requirement: The served export contains exactly the pinned vision runtime, ASL model and committed recognition worker; demo:serve refuses anything else.

check.contains: does not match its pinned size and SHA-256

check.contains: contains the automated rehearsal hook

automated.requirement: A recognition change cannot add a wrong acceptance or silently change an outcome on the 11 established development trials.

check.contains: NEW WRONG ACCEPTANCE

automated.requirement: Automated software rehearsal: on the rehearsal build, synthetic landmarks for the six-word script produce the six words in order through the real camera loop, abstain on everyday movements, and survive a camera interruption.

check.contains: Six-sign sequence

automated.requirement: Repeated start/pause, rapid cancels, hidden tabs and workspace re-entry release the camera and never leak recognition workers.

check.contains: Start/pause must not leak recognition workers

automated.requirement: Worker crashes restart at most twice a minute and then wait for a manual restart; missing or corrupted tracking models release the camera with a clear message and recover.

check.contains: A third crash within a minute must pause recognition

automated.requirement: Keyboard reaches every workspace control with visible focus; touch targets are at least 24×24 px on a 390 px phone viewport; reduced motion stops animations.

check.contains: Touch targets under 24×24 CSS px

manual_before_demo.requirement: On the demo laptop's real webcam, open the workspace with ?perf and confirm at least 10 frames analysed/s (YES is lost at 5–8 fps in synthetic tests); then start the camera, sign each of the six words twice, and record per-word outcomes (correct / wrong / no match / camera or tracking failure) with npm run eval:log, or on paper. Do not publish them as accuracy.
Hold hands at rest for 30 s and perform the everyday controls in docs/gitex/known-false-accept-risks.json; record any word that appears.
Serve the ASL demo build with `npm run demo:serve`, unplug the network after the page has loaded, and repeat MAN-1 once.
Deny camera permission once, then allow it; pull the webcam (or disable it) mid-session and confirm the recovery message.
Confirm auto speak voices only confirmed words on the demo laptop speakers.

not_claimed: Sentence or continuous ASL translation, grammar, facial grammar or fingerspelling.
Measured accuracy for any language, signer, device or lighting condition.
False-acceptance rates for non-signing or unsupported signs.
status: NO-GO. All five manual_before_demo gates are pending; they need the physical demo laptop, webcam and a signer.
